messages.text: now import Rainbow Rave. get creative..

Your x.com Rainbow Rave has the rolling rainbow, the trance loop made in code, the kick zoom, and the fast mini-rainbow on its "rave checks" badges. I'm bringing all of that over, then giving every mod on this page its own rave look.

ran trif check timsrobot.com/rave && trif reload && trif errors; trif run 'const s=document.querySelector("svg.robot");return {g:!!s.querySelector("#trif-rave-robot"), bg:getComputedStyle(document.documentElement,"::before").animationName}'
Rainbow page, rainbow robot. The other mods still look like themselves on top of it, so each gets a rave version next.
ran trif check timsrobot.com/rave && trif check timsrobot.com/shooter && trif reload && trif errors; trif screenshot -o rave2.png
One more idea: on this page the music and the zoom are simply part of the rave, and their buttons become a prize for beating the robot.
ran trif reload && trif run -f sites/timsrobot.com/_win-test.js; trif screenshot -o win.png

Rainbow Rave is on timsrobot.com. It's a new mod, **Rainbow Rave**, ported from your Rainbow Rave mod for x.com, with a rave look for every mod on this page.

**From the x.com version:**
- The rolling rainbow behind the whole page, with white text on top.
- The trance loop, made in code (no sound files). It starts on your first click or key press.
- The kick zoom: the page's blocks pulse with every kick drum.

**Every mod raves:**
- **Robot:** his outline, eyes and legs roll through the rainbow, faster the more you've hurt him in the shooter, and he blows up in a big rainbow blast.
- **Title:** each letter a different neon colour around the rainbow, with a glow that adds light, and no flicker. It still waves.
- **Tagline, checklist, LED sign:** "your own coding agent" glows rainbow letter by letter, ticked boxes and icons roll through the rainbow, and the LED letters change colour as they scroll.
- **Buttons:** "Get it" is a rolling rainbow and "GitHub" gets rainbow letters. They still wobble.
- **Ship:** rainbow exhaust, and a rainbow ring pulses out on every kick. "ROBOT DESTROYED" spins in, in rainbow letters.

**A prize:** here the music and zoom have no buttons; they're part of the rave. Beat the robot in Space Shooter with every mod switched on, and when you come back from the win ("play again?"), play/pause and zoom buttons pop in along the top of the window, switched off for you to turn on. This browser remembers you've won.

**What I checked:** after a reload there were no errors, the screenshot shows the rainbow page and robot, and a test win brought the buttons in. I can't hear from here, so turn it up.

To undo it, switch off **Rainbow Rave** in the side panel, or ask me to.
